stem.text: Which graph shows the variation with time $t$ of the velocity $v$ of an object falling vertically downwards in a vacuum?

A.alt: Graph of v against t: straight line falling from the v axis to the t axis.

B.alt: Graph of v against t: curve falling from the v axis and levelling off towards the t axis.

C.alt: Graph of v against t: curve rising from the origin and levelling off.

D.alt: Graph of v against t: straight line rising from the origin.
